Script.name: mmapper
Script.script:
if _G.mm_loader_in_progress then return end _G.mm_loader_in_progress = true
local home = getMudletHomeDir() local initPath = home .. "/mmapper/mm_init.lua" mm = mm or {} mm.base_dir = home .. "/mmapper"
local ok, err = pcall(dofile, initPath) _G.mm_loader_in_progress = false
if not ok then cecho("<orange_red>[MMAPPER ERROR]<reset> Failed to load " .. initPath .. ": " .. tostring(err) .. "\n") end
